//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Hand Over Your Items -> Config

Enable Hand Over Your Items.//: Whether Hand Over Your Items is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

sendItemReceivedMessage.//: If enabled, players will receive a message when they have been given an item.

sendItemGivenMessage.//: If enabled, players will receive a message when they give an item.

mustCrouchToGiveItem.//: If enabled, players will only be able to give items when they are crouching/sneaking.
